task.description: Independently re-verify all 14 acceptance criteria of REQ-202 against actual current source and real command output, re-running the full test suite and merge-readiness checks myself rather than trusting TEST-RUNNER's or any prior agent's report.

result.summary: All 14 acceptance criteria independently re-verified against real source and real command output; see handoffs/WF02-REQ202-20260830/release-validation-report-20260830.md for the full per-AC evidence. Key independent findings: (1) read canonicaliser.ex and promotion_digest.ex moduledocs side by side myself -- genuine substantive bidirectional cross-reference confirmed, not a token mention; git diff main...HEAD -- lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_digest.ex is a single 9-line, purely-additive, moduledoc-only hunk with no change to canonicalize/1, compute_plan_digest/1, or verify_digest/2. (2) Read the migration's trigger DDL and top-of-file comment directly -- AC7's DB-level immutability and AC10's placement-with-reason statement both confirmed from the actual file, not from a report describing it. (3) Read Artifact's and Repository's moduledocs via Code.fetch_docs/1 myself for AC11/AC12 -- both required statements present in the compiled module, matching what the pinning tests assert. (4) Ran git diff main...HEAD --stat myself for AC13 -- no lib/letflow_web/, lib/letflow/routers/, or web/ path in the 34-file diff. (5) Re-ran mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix format --check-formatted myself: both clean, exit 0. (6) Ran bash scripts/test_parallel.sh myself, foreground, twice: the first run collided with an earlier auto-backgrounded invocation of the same script (both contending for the same Postgres connections simultaneously), producing a corrupted result (28 failures, 2 partitions crashed) -- recognized as environmental contention (confirmed no leftover mix test/test_parallel processes before rerunning) and discarded, not treated as a code defect. The clean, single, uncontended rerun matched TEST-RUNNER's recheck1 figures exactly: combined 2861 tests, 6 properties, 2 failures (2865/2867 passed), both failures independently grepped from the partition-3 log and confirmed to be exactly Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest's documented rustc-absent baseline (which rustc/which cargo both empty in this sandbox), nothing else. (7) Independently confirmed the tenant_fixture.ex oracle-rot fix (from step-02a-elixir-dev-rework3) is real by grepping the file directly: both 'artifact_versions' and 'repository_artifacts' present, count assertion bumped to 29, migration registered in Letflow.TenantProvisioning.tenant_scoped_migrations/0's manifest. No acceptance criterion found unmet; no claim in the pipeline history found to not hold up under independent re-verification.
checks_passed: AC1-AC4: canonicaliser and dedup tests read and confirmed genuine (byte-level assertions, real SHA-256 comparisons, negative controls)
AC5/AC6: moduledocs read side-by-side, genuine cross-reference confirmed; git diff on promotion_digest.ex confirmed moduledoc-only
AC7: migration trigger DDL read directly, matches design §5 and req195 precedent
AC8/AC9: version-sequencing and pagination tests read and confirmed to re-fetch from DB, not trust in-memory structs
AC10/AC11: migration file comment and Artifact moduledoc read directly, both required statements present verbatim
AC12: Repository moduledoc read directly, REQ-041 disambiguation present
AC13: git diff main...HEAD --stat run myself, no route/controller/web file in the diff

AC14: mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean, mix format --check-formatted clean, full suite re-run twice (contention discarded, clean rerun matches recheck1: 2865/2867, only documented rustc-absent baseline remains)
Tenant-fixture oracle-rot fix independently confirmed in test/support/tenant_fixture.ex and the tenant provisioning manifest
